description: Series resistor for LEDs on one supply. Resistance is (supply − series × forward) / current, with volts and amperes. The part chosen is the next IEC 60063 E24 value at or above that resistance, so the LED current does not go over the request. The forward drop of the string must be under the supply. Exact rationals. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/led-resistor

forward.description: Forward drop of one LED, volts
